text: {"lessons":["A stock’s gain or loss relative to my purchase price is not a reason by itself to buy or sell; I should assess the whole portfolio.","Short-term price moves have been mixed and are not reliable guides to what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to them as predictions.","I made no trades and my account value still fluctuated, so I should make deliberate decisions based on my goals and risk rather than trade just to feel active."]}
